mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recurring_item (user_id, name, type, amount, category_id, payment_method_id, day_of_month, adjust, active, memo, installment_total, installment_months, installment_start) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{categoryId}, #{paymentMethodId}, #{dayOfMonth}, #{adjust}, #{active}, #{memo}, #{installmentTotal}, #{installmentMonths}, #{installmentStart})
